tests.name: TestTeamsSentSideEffectMarkerFailureGetsDurableRetryGate
tests.oracle: a transient final marker-CAS failure leaves Sent work pending behind a durable retry gate and the next due pass clears it
tests.baseline: pre-fix marker-CAS failure had no retry gate and replayed post-send effects on every listener tick

tests.name: TestImportCheckpointComparisonIncludesAllProgressFields
tests.oracle: all partial/source-change/opaque cursor fields are semantic while UpdatedAt alone remains ignorable
tests.baseline: pre-fix a hand-maintained comparator omitted new progress fields and dropped durable scanner advancement

tests.name: TestClaimControlLeaseDoesNotOverwriteFreshLegacyOwnerWithoutLeaseHistory
tests.oracle: a fresh pre-generation owner without lease history remains the sole ownership witness, while a replacement stays standby until the owner is stale
tests.baseline: pre-fix an upgrade-era owner row with no lease tuple could be preempted by the first new process and create two writers

tests.name: TestSQLiteCorruptControlLeaseDoesNotTrustStaleColdCopy
tests.oracle: a corrupt current lease row cannot be replaced from an expired cold snapshot while a fresh runtime heartbeat proves the old holder is alive
tests.baseline: pre-fix stale cold lease metadata could authorize a replacement owner after the current SQLite lease row became unreadable

tests.name: TestBridgeListenDoesNotLeakControlLeaseWhenInitialOwnerHeartbeatFails
tests.oracle: a listener that encounters a fresh legacy owner returns standby without leaving a new lease, and a later stale-owner claim can take over
tests.baseline: pre-fix startup ownership failure could leave a lease behind or overwrite a fresh legacy owner before heartbeat confirmation

tests.name: TestGraphMessagePageRejectsMissingOrNullValue
tests.oracle: missing, null, top-level null, and non-array value fields are rejected as invalid message pages instead of becoming empty successful pages
tests.baseline: pre-fix a 2xx response without a usable value array decoded as an empty Graph page

tests.name: TestPollFrontierInvalidContinuationPageOpensGapWithoutAdvancingCursor
tests.oracle: an invalid 2xx continuation page opens the bounded directional gap and preserves the safe predecessor cursor
tests.baseline: pre-fix an empty decoded continuation could clear the durable continuation as if it were a terminal success

tests.name: TestPollFrontierMalformedHeadResponseOpensBoundedGap
tests.oracle: a bad head nextLink or identity-less oversized record becomes a bounded gap without advancing the previous cursor
tests.baseline: pre-fix deterministic head boundary errors stayed on an unbounded retry path and never made recovery progress

tests.name: TestClaimControlLeaseRejectsUntrustedActiveOwnerProjection
tests.oracle: a live lease is not taken over when the service-owner projection is empty or legacy-incomplete, while a matching lock-owner copy remains authoritative
tests.baseline: pre-fix a syntactically valid but semantically incomplete service-owner row could make a same-machine replacement take over an unexpired lease

tests.name: TestChatMessagesGapPathUsesSupportedExclusiveDateOperators
tests.oracle: directional recovery emits only provider-supported exclusive gt/lt bounds and preserves an explicit empty interval
tests.baseline: pre-fix recovery emitted unsupported inclusive ge/le filters and Graph returned HTTP 400 forever

tests.name: TestListenerRecoveryGraphPageUsesExclusiveBoundsWithSafeOverlap
tests.oracle: a strict Graph boundary accepts the recovery page, including equal-timestamp overlap, without a provider 400
tests.baseline: pre-fix the listener repeatedly used Graph-incompatible inclusive operators

tests.name: TestPollFrontierEmptyGapRecoveryRetainsEvidenceWithoutSpinning
tests.oracle: an empty directional recovery page retains the gap evidence, schedules a bounded head probe, and does not remain an operational tight loop
tests.baseline: pre-fix an empty recovery page either retired the gap unsafely or retried the same path forever

tests.name: TestTeamsBacklogFairQuantumDelaysInitialRunAndReservesOptionalSlots
tests.oracle: a durable Teams backlog suppresses optional work initially, then grants one bounded fair quantum without removing mandatory recovery
tests.baseline: pre-fix optional work either ran on every backlog cycle or was starved forever

tests.name: TestTeamsBacklogFairQuantumDiscoversRecentLinkedSessionWithoutCheckpoint
tests.oracle: a recent linked transcript without an import checkpoint receives a bounded discovery slot during a continuing Teams backlog
tests.baseline: pre-fix the global backlog gate made newly-created local conversations invisible indefinitely

tests.name: TestTeamsMainLoopOutboxReservesTwoHeadsForAnotherChat
tests.oracle: a multi-chat main-loop flush sends two FIFO heads from each of two selected chats, stops at four total, and leaves the third row for a later cycle
tests.baseline: pre-fix the fairness path sent only one row per selected chat, leaving half of the bounded durable send capacity unused

tests.name: TestTeamsMainLoopOutboxRotatesBeyondFirstTwoChats
tests.oracle: bounded main-loop outbox delivery gives two messages per selected chat, retains per-chat FIFO, and rotates a third chat into a later cycle
tests.baseline: pre-fix the first two continuously-active chats could starve every later chat, while the one-message quantum left durable capacity unused

tests.name: TestTeamsOperationalBacklogKeepsFuture429RecoveryRequired
tests.oracle: a future 429 retry releases optional maintenance only for an ordinary frontier, while recovery-required state remains visible
tests.baseline: pre-fix a broad future-429 exception could hide an unresolved recovery marker

tests.name: TestTeamsGraph429PollAutomaticallyRecoversWithoutManualUnblock
tests.oracle: finite chat-scoped GET 429 responses install a durable Retry-After gate and the same listener poll loop automatically reaches a successful read without clearing schedule state
tests.baseline: pre-fix the recovery test was not CI-selected and a retry gate could be lost or require manual unblocking

tests.name: TestTeamsGraph429SQLiteAdmissionDoesNotLoseTheRetry
tests.oracle: after a durable SQLite chat-scoped GET 429 gate, idle admission still selects the due retry and reaches a successful read without cursor rollback
tests.baseline: pre-fix SQLite retry rows could be hidden by idle filtering after the provider gate expired

tests.name: TestTeamsListenFalseAccountRead429RecoversWithoutManualStateChange
tests.oracle: a finite account/global read throttle is durably fenced, does not permit sibling Graph reads during Retry-After, and the same continuous listener later drains both chats without manual schedule mutation
tests.baseline: pre-fix CI exercised pollOnce or an indefinitely blocked listener, so a full listener could busy-loop, lose the shared gate, or fail to recover after an account/global read 429

tests.name: TestTeamsListenFalseChatRead429RecoversWithoutManualStateChange
tests.oracle: a finite chat-local read throttle leaves a healthy sibling progressing and the same continuous listener later retries the throttled chat without manual schedule mutation
tests.baseline: pre-fix chat-local read failures could be treated as a shared blocker or require an external schedule wake before the failed chat progressed

tests.name: TestTeamsListenFalseAccountRead429DoesNotBlockQueuedOutboxWrite
tests.oracle: a queued local outbox write completes while every account-level message-list GET is rate-limited, without replaying or losing the durable outbox row
tests.baseline: pre-fix the read phase could prevent the independent write phase from flushing already durable local work

tests.name: TestSQLiteOperationalBacklogTreatsSemanticallyInvalidPollAsRecovery
tests.oracle: valid-but-undecodable poll JSON remains visible as recovery work even when its materialized frontier hint is false
tests.baseline: pre-fix shallow SQLite JSON checks could hide a malformed poll and release expensive optional phases

tests.name: TestSQLiteChatPollFrontierHintRepairIsVersioned
tests.oracle: the frontier hint is repaired once per predicate version while independent NULL scheduling-column repair still runs on reopen
tests.baseline: pre-fix every compatibility save rewrote all chat poll frontier hints and amplified SQLite locks

tests.name: TestSQLiteBackfillRepairsStaleDormantGapHint
tests.oracle: a stale positive frontier hint is repaired from the canonical dormant-gap JSON on reopen
tests.baseline: pre-fix SQLite and JSON backends disagreed about whether a dormant gap blocked optional maintenance

tests.name: TestDockerRealDataGraphServerEnforcesFilterAndOpaquePagination
tests.oracle: the strict local Graph boundary rejects ge/le, accepts provider-issued opaque continuation tokens, and paginates descending messages without duplication
tests.baseline: pre-fix the experiment either accepted an unsupported filter or rejected copied provider cursors before exercising production recovery

tests.name: TestTeamsLinkedRecoveryCombinedQuantumReachesBothLanes
tests.oracle: mandatory and optional linked recovery share one bounded quantum without allowing either lane to starve
tests.baseline: pre-fix separate modulo cursors could repeatedly reserve optional slots while the mandatory tail never ran

tests.name: TestTeamsLinkedRecoveryCombinedQuantumSurvivesRestart
tests.oracle: the combined linked recovery quantum remains fair after a Bridge restart and keeps the same durable frontier owner-fenced
tests.baseline: pre-fix fairness selection was process-local and restart could replay the same prefix indefinitely

tests.name: TestTeamsLinkedDiscoveryQuantumAdvancesPastFailingPrefix
tests.oracle: bounded recent-file linked discovery advances beyond a repeatedly failing prefix and reaches the tail after restart
tests.baseline: pre-fix a four-times-larger candidate window could keep selecting only the failing prefix

tests.name: TestOptionalMaintenanceFairDueIsDurableAndOwnerFenced
tests.oracle: optional fairness due state survives restart and stale owners cannot rewrite or clear it
tests.baseline: pre-fix fairness scheduling was process-local and could be lost or overwritten during owner replacement

tests.name: TestBacklogFairCursorUsesExpectedCAS
tests.oracle: a fairness cursor persists only from the expected owner and expected prior cursor, so a stale worker cannot skip another worker's quantum
tests.baseline: pre-fix owner-fenced cursor writes did not protect the in-memory predecessor value

tests.name: TestPendingPageRepairIdentityIncludesDurableSemantics
tests.oracle: malformed pending-page repair requires the complete durable attempt and poll row to remain unchanged before opening a gap
tests.baseline: pre-fix identity-only repair could clear or rewrite a concurrently changed frontier

tests.name: TestDockerRealDataInheritedOutboxRowsAreRejectedFromSyntheticAccounting

tests.baseline: pre-fix inherited queued/sending/accepted work could make a real-data experiment pass without processing the replay corpus

tests.name: TestDockerRealDataPostMarkerRequiresExactRenderedBody
tests.oracle: unknown POST injection matches only the exact rendered target body and cannot be consumed by a suffix, metadata, or unrelated message

tests.name: TestDockerRealDataRequestDiagnosticRedactsOpaqueContinuation
tests.oracle: fake Graph diagnostics never print provider opaque continuation values
tests.baseline: pre-fix list/unknown route diagnostics could expose raw provider cursors in test output

tests.name: TestDockerRealDataReplayCorpusPersistsAcrossProcessBoundary
tests.oracle: the copied replay corpus survives a new container process without rebuilding from mutated durable inbound rows
tests.baseline: pre-fix the second process could accidentally rebuild or duplicate the synthetic workload

tests.name: TestHistoryTieredListSessionFilesReadsDirectoryInBoundedBatches
tests.oracle: recent history discovery enumerates a large directory in interruptible bounded batches while retaining the complete sorted candidate set
tests.baseline: pre-fix os.ReadDir materialized the entire sessions directory before phase cancellation could be observed

tests.name: TestBacklogFairCursorDoesNotPersistAfterPhaseCancellation
tests.oracle: a canceled maintenance phase cannot persist a consumed fairness cursor, while a live phase remains eligible
tests.baseline: pre-fix linked recovery and discovery used inconsistent context guards around cursor persistence

tests.name: TestSQLiteMalformedEchoPrefixBeyondLegacyPageCapDoesNotHideCandidate
tests.oracle: a valid Sending receipt remains discoverable after more than eight pages of SQL-admitted but Go-invalid rows
tests.baseline: pre-fix the fixed echo page cap permanently hid a valid receipt behind a malformed prefix

tests.name: TestSQLiteBlankOutboxCompatibilityProjectionUsesCanonicalJSON
tests.oracle: blank nullable compatibility columns do not hide a runnable canonical outbox row
tests.baseline: pre-fix SQL admitted blank projections but the Go matcher skipped them as contradictions

tests.name: TestSQLiteProjectionBackfillRepairsStaleSessionAndChatPollScalarsAcrossRestart
tests.oracle: startup repairs stale session/chat-poll indexed projections from identity-checked canonical JSON and hot admission includes the chat, active turn, and importing checkpoint
tests.baseline: pre-fix stale scalar identity and schedule columns could hide healthy work after a mixed-version write

tests.name: TestSQLiteTerminalIdentityConflictingTurnSurvivesFullStateRewrite
tests.oracle: a terminal turn whose canonical identity conflicts with its SQLite row identity survives an unrelated full rewrite without becoming runnable typed state
tests.baseline: pre-fix full-state serialization could delete opaque terminal evidence needed for safe execution recovery

tests.name: TestSQLiteFullStateRewriteHonorsCanceledContext
tests.oracle: a canceled SQLite full-state rewrite stops before destructive replacement and leaves the existing durable state readable
tests.baseline: pre-fix a canceled migration or rewrite could ignore caller cancellation while replacing durable tables

tests.name: TestUnscopedQueuedTurnClaimDoesNotCrossOwnerGenerationAcrossBackends
tests.oracle: an unscoped queued-turn claim does not skip a generation-bound FIFO head or adopt work belonging to another owner on either backend
tests.baseline: pre-fix the legacy claim path could cross an owner generation boundary while looking for a later queued turn

tests.name: TestSQLiteLegacyEmptyRuntimeProjectionBootstrapsOnceForHotPoll
tests.oracle: an old SQLite store with an empty runtime projection materializes the narrow runtime rows once and serves hot poll scheduling without repeated cold-state fallback
tests.baseline: pre-fix every hot poll could decode the full state_json document when the legacy runtime projection was empty

tests.name: TestSQLiteProjectionMarkersSurviveFullStateRewrite
tests.oracle: completed SQLite projection markers survive unrelated full-state rewrites so startup does not repeat a large repair pass
tests.baseline: pre-fix a full save could discard migration markers and reopen the projection backfill on every write

tests.name: TestSQLiteMalformedNumericCompatibilityColumnsDoNotAbortRecovery
tests.oracle: malformed numeric compatibility projections remain isolated while canonical session and poll rows stay readable and an unrelated durable update completes
tests.baseline: pre-fix a malformed scalar projection could abort recovery or make a healthy canonical row unavailable

tests.name: TestQueueTurnRejectsMissingInboundWithoutCreatingOrphanAcrossBackends
tests.oracle: an explicit missing inbound identity is rejected without creating a durable orphan Turn on either backend
tests.baseline: pre-fix QueueTurn silently created a Turn whose inbound event did not exist

tests.name: TestRequeueTurnDoesNotReviveIgnoredInboundAcrossBackends
tests.oracle: requeue of a running Turn linked to an ignored inbound produces an interrupted Turn and never requeues or reschedules the inbound
tests.baseline: pre-fix RequeueTurn changed a terminally ignored inbound back to queued

tests.name: TestInterruptedTurnDoesNotIgnoreForeignInboundAcrossBackends
tests.oracle: interrupting a Turn cannot change an inbound row owned by another session or Turn
tests.baseline: pre-fix interruption cleanup looked up only the inbound ID and could mutate foreign durable state

tests.name: TestRecoverQueuedTurnStopsBeforeGraphOnForeignInboundProvenance
tests.oracle: queued recovery interrupts a cross-session inbound reference and emits a durable notice without issuing a Graph read
tests.baseline: pre-fix recovery could use an inbound row outside the requested session before checking provenance

tests.name: TestGraphUploadDriveItemFromFileDoesNotRecreateSessionAfterUnknownFinalPut
tests.oracle: a lost final PUT response followed by a 404 status probe returns an indeterminate result and issues exactly one createUploadSession POST
tests.baseline: pre-fix the probe 404 entered the expired-session loop and could create a second remote upload session

tests.name: TestSQLiteHotPollScalarTrustRevokesContradictoryJSONWithMatchingRevision
tests.oracle: an atomic canonical/scalar contradiction with matching revision and trust is revoked, including primary-key mutation
tests.baseline: pre-fix revision equality alone could admit contradictory scalar hot-path state

tests.name: TestSQLiteHotPollTrustedReadyUsesCanonicalTimeForDueGate
tests.oracle: a canonical future next_poll_at prevents scalar due admission even when scalar values remain due and trusted
tests.baseline: pre-fix a trusted scalar due gate could run a chat whose canonical schedule was still future

tests.name: TestSQLitePreparationStateLockFencesOrdinaryWriter
tests.oracle: ordinary state writers cannot publish through the state-file lock while SQLite schema preparation holds its destructive maintenance boundary
tests.baseline: pre-fix a compatibility writer could race DDL/backfill and replace canonical state or leave projections partially repaired

tests.name: TestSQLiteSessionBackfillRejectsSourceChangeBeforeMarker
tests.oracle: a session projection backfill rejects a canonical row change and publishes neither a cursor nor a completed marker
tests.baseline: pre-fix zero-row compatibility updates could be mistaken for successful repair and advance the durable backfill cursor

tests.name: TestSQLiteChatSequenceBackfillRejectsSourceChangeBeforeMarker
tests.oracle: a chat-sequence projection backfill rechecks state_json_revision and never publishes a stale sequence marker after a canonical write
tests.baseline: pre-fix a scan/publication race could make the scalar sequence projection appear current while it was built from an older cold document

tests.name: TestSQLiteCopiedPreparationClaimCanBeReclaimedByPhysicalIdentity
tests.oracle: a preparation claim copied with a different SQLite physical identity is reclaimed, while same-file and legacy claims remain hard fences
tests.baseline: pre-fix copied databases could inherit a foreign claim and remain permanently stuck in schema preparation

tests.name: TestSQLiteOwnerMigrationAlreadyDBRequiresCurrentLease
tests.oracle: an already-migrated SQLite store is accepted only for the exact current owner generation and rejects a stale generation
tests.baseline: pre-fix the already-DB migration branch could validate or repair the store without the current control lease

tests.name: TestOutboxGraphPreflightFailureReleasesStartedAttachmentBoundaries
tests.oracle: a no-network Graph preflight callback releases only the exact stale attachment boundary on both stores, allowing a replacement owner to reclaim it
tests.baseline: pre-fix a lost owner could leave Sending plus started attachment markers forever or clear a replacement attempt

tests.name: TestOutboxGraphPreflightFailureRejectsWrongAttemptToken
tests.oracle: a preflight reducer with the wrong send attempt token leaves the Sending row and its external-side-effect fence unchanged
tests.baseline: pre-fix a stale local callback could release a newer outbox attempt into a duplicate-replay path

tests.name: TestGraphReadRateLimitDoesNotInstallOutboxWriteGate
tests.oracle: an explicit Graph read 429 persists only the read retry gate and never installs a same-chat or account outbox write gate
tests.baseline: pre-fix read throttling could block unrelated queued Teams writes for the entire chat or account

tests.name: TestOutboxGraphPreflightFailureRejectsUnwitnessedStartedBoundary
tests.oracle: a started attachment boundary without the exact attempt witness remains Sending and cannot be released by a local preflight callback on either backend
tests.baseline: pre-fix a legacy or foreign started marker could be mistaken for the current no-network attempt and replay an unknown POST

tests.name: TestBridgeUploadSessionOwnerFenceStopsCreateBeforeHTTP
tests.oracle: a lease takeover observed after Graph authentication but before createUploadSession issues no POST and returns the outbox to the replayable queued lane
tests.baseline: pre-fix the upload-session preflight error could be classified as an unknown POST or leave a local claim parked

tests.name: TestSQLiteSessionBackfillRollsBackEarlierRowsAfterLaterSourceChange
tests.oracle: a canonical session change after earlier derived rows were written rolls back the whole backfill page, leaving JSON, scalar trust, cursor, and marker unchanged
tests.baseline: pre-fix a later source change could leave a partially repaired session projection before the durable marker fence

tests.name: TestSQLiteChatSequenceBackfillRollsBackAfterSourceRevisionChangesInTransaction
tests.oracle: a canonical state revision change triggered during sequence projection publication rolls back inserted sequence rows and leaves marker/cursor unpublished; canceled work returns promptly
tests.baseline: pre-fix chat-sequence backfill could publish a stale projection or ignore context cancellation while decoding a legacy JSON page

tests.name: TestOutboxMissingDriveItemRequeuesOnlyPendingAttachmentAttempt
tests.oracle: a definitive missing DriveItem resets only a pending attachment attempt on both stores; stale callbacks and started final POST boundaries remain fenced
tests.baseline: pre-fix stale callbacks could clear a replacement attempt, while stale DriveItem metadata could keep an attachment in a permanent 404 loop

tests.name: TestBridgeRequeuesPendingAttachmentWhenDriveItemIsGone
tests.oracle: a metadata 404 for a pending attachment clears the stale DriveItem, installs one bounded retry gate, and issues no chat POST
tests.baseline: pre-fix every retry repeated the same metadata GET/404 while retaining the stale remote identity

tests.name: TestDefinitiveDriveItemMissingErrorIsNarrowlyScoped
tests.oracle: only GET 404/410 responses from the /me/drive/items metadata route are eligible for stale-identity recovery; permission, wrong-route, and POST errors are rejected
tests.baseline: pre-fix broad status matching could erase a durable remote identity on an unrelated Graph error

tests.name: TestMarkOutboxAttachmentMessagePostStartedForAttemptPersistsAndFences
tests.oracle: the attachment POST started marker is exact-attempt fenced and an explicit rejection atomically returns that exact row to pending without clearing a replacement attempt
tests.baseline: pre-fix a rejected attachment POST could remain marked started and keep the outbox in an unreplayable or indefinitely waiting state

tests.name: TestBridgeAttachmentMessagePost401ResetsBoundaryAndRetries
tests.oracle: an explicit attachment POST 401 resets only the exact started boundary and the later retry sends exactly once with a durable Teams identity
tests.baseline: pre-fix the generic retry path left the post boundary started after authentication rejection, so the retry could wait forever

tests.name: TestSQLiteQueuedTurnSessionIDsUsesStableTypedPages
tests.oracle: typed queued-turn candidate pages are stable, exclude a session with a running turn, and preserve the next exclusive cursor boundary
tests.baseline: pre-fix full queued-turn snapshots decoded unrelated state before one bounded start and could repeatedly revisit or mis-handle shared-session turns

tests.name: TestSQLiteQueuedTurnSessionIDsFallsBackOnUntrustedTurnProjection
tests.oracle: stale markers or row-local untrusted turn projections use the canonical JSON fallback and do not hide a queued session
tests.baseline: pre-fix a stale scalar turn projection could make the queued-turn drain report an empty queue and strand durable work

tests.name: TestSQLiteQueuedTurnSessionIDsNativePagesCoverLargeCandidateSet
tests.oracle: a candidate set larger than one page is returned exactly once in lexical keyset order without a count query
tests.baseline: pre-fix bounded queued-turn admission had no stable page contract and could materialize the complete turn/session snapshot for every cycle

tests.name: TestBridgeSQLiteQueuedTurnAdmissionUsesPagedSelectedSessions
tests.oracle: the listener starts only the bounded selected session in one cycle, advances its durable candidate cursor, and reaches the next session in a later cycle
tests.baseline: pre-fix queued-turn admission hydrated the complete durable snapshot before applying the per-cycle start bound

tests.name: TestSQLiteNativeOutboxCursorDoesNotSkipSubMillisecondProjectionTear
tests.oracle: a trusted scalar projection that differs from canonical JSON by a sub-millisecond timestamp cannot make an exclusive pending cursor skip the row; the query enters canonical fallback
tests.baseline: pre-fix the scalar created_at cursor predicate could exclude a canonical row before JSON decoding and permanently strand the next page

tests.name: TestBridgeAmbiguousRecoverySharesPageBudgetAcrossCandidates
tests.oracle: one ambiguous recovery sweep shares its bounded Graph evidence-page budget across candidates, preserves unknown rows, and never falls through to POST
tests.baseline: pre-fix resetting the page budget per candidate multiplied cold Graph reads and could delay known queued delivery without changing durable state
